task_description: Build a complete, reproducible educational AWS observability lab (metrics+logs + distributed tracing) running fully via Docker Compose on internal network obsnet, validated locally. Two FastAPI apps, ~8 containerized services, Grafana dashboards, load-test script, pytest tests, and two exhaustive Spanish Markdown tutorials. No AWS resources are created by this task; tutorials document the real EC2 (t3.small, AL2023) deployment.
